facts.text: I am considering my career options in journalism.
I see myself getting my news online more often these days.
I think getting news online is more convenient than buying a physical newspaper or waiting for TV news.
I think technology has changed how people consume news.
I think technology is a double-edged sword because it makes news more accessible but also makes misleading information easier to spread.
I want to know whether there is a way to combat fake news in the digital age.

keyphrases: areas of journalism in high demand
